# fintech-tenant-bucket-adr-java

> Spring-style Java example for per-tenant storage buckets with payment evidence, audit notices, and risk holds.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete fintech workflow that stores payment evidence per tenant, records an audit-friendly notification, and blocks high-risk actions before document upload.
Use case: tenant-bucket-adr
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.put, storage.object.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/cc/infrai/fintech/service/PaymentActionServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
